entries.cause: Same-construct blocking and an explicit-declaration-only property signature.
entries.next_discriminator: Replay the rule unchanged on untouched ontology families.
entries.observation: V2 mapped 1335 of 1434 frozen reference cells and omitted 64 binary equivalence pairs.
entries.repair: Full cross-construct enumeration plus input-only class/property-position signature closure mapped 1399 of 1399 binary equivalence pairs.
entries.residual: Repair was designed after public gold and has no protected authority.

entries.cause: The evaluator lacked an explicit CANNOT_CHECK state for reference-domain and relation-schema limits.
entries.next_discriminator: Predeclare domain and expressibility contracts before gold on a new benchmark.
entries.observation: V2 mixed 35 non-binary relations and one missing reference member into an all-cell recall gate and closed-world output.
entries.repair: V3 maps 35 of 35 non-binary pairs, 2415 test-105 cases, and 72941 out-of-domain cases to CANNOT_CHECK.
entries.residual: Reference-domain completeness is benchmark-specific and public-gold-informed.

entries.cause: AML and exact-label equality are correlated and share representation failures; double-negative agreement does not certify obstruction.
entries.next_discriminator: Develop a structure-aware evidence-adequacy certificate and require source-disjoint coverage 1.0.
entries.observation: The predecessor rule had 304 V2 envelope failures and 333 failures on the wider V3 scorable census.
entries.repair: The maximal binary envelope removes singleton claims and attains coverage 1.0.
entries.residual: No nontrivial proper subenvelope is licensed.

entries.cause: Coverage is obtained by unresolved output on every scorable case.
entries.next_discriminator: Require a proper envelope with coverage 1.0 and harm noninferiority in every frozen regime.
entries.observation: The maximal envelope has harm 0.25 in every regime and candidate-minus-AML deltas [0.2247994300931187, 0.22473158403582272, 0.19352239767966484].
entries.repair: None; this is the explicit coverage-risk frontier.
entries.residual: V3 has no harm superiority and no useful point yield.

entries.cause: No referent-no-change control, no joint coordinate separation, and no independent coordinate adjudicator.
entries.next_discriminator: Construct independently adjudicated factorial contrasts with referent and construct varied separately.
entries.observation: All 117914 scorable cases have REFERENT_1 operational IRI contrast; 75512 also have construct contrast.
entries.repair: V3 reports joint contrasts and narrows the result to descriptive opportunity.

entries.cause: One historical external matcher and one seed family do not establish the current guarded frontier.
entries.next_discriminator: Bind current matchers, replay upstream runtime, and execute untouched multi-family validation under external custody.
entries.observation: AML v3.2 is reproducible on 19 pairs but test 206 is unparsable and execution deviates from the named Java 8 runtime.
